privacy: This draft explains how Bizora handles personal information for shop owners and their customers. It is not legal advice and it has not been signed off by a lawyer.
Bizora is used by businesses in Nigeria and other countries. Data protection law applies where the people are, such as the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 for people in Nigeria.

We use that information to run your business account: sign-in, shops and staff, customers and what they owe, sales, stock, suppliers and money. We do not sell personal data. This public site does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
Phone numbers are stored so you can call or open WhatsApp. A walk-in customer can be saved without a phone. You are responsible for telling your customers why you keep their details.

Some work is done for us by other companies: Google Cloud hosts the service and reads photos and voice notes you choose to send for capture (they come back as draft rows for you to check), and an email service sends sign-in and invitation emails.

Authorised Bizora staff may see a business's records, read-only, to give support, fix faults, keep the service secure or meet the law, as the Terms of use explain. Customers' phone numbers and emails are partly hidden from them, and every look is recorded and shown to the owner.

You can ask us to correct or delete your account data. The owner can download all of the business's records at any time, from Settings. Customer records you entered belong to your business and are removed when that business is deleted.

While Bizora is being tried with a small number of businesses (the pilot), we count how it is used, to find problems and improve it: for example how many sales were made offline, whether a change sent from a phone was refused, or whether a voice download failed. These counts never include what was said or typed, amounts, names or phone numbers.

To let you work with no network, the app keeps some records on the phone or computer you use: your products, prices and stock, the names of customers you may sell to (names only, never their phone numbers or emails), and the work you do until it is sent. It stays on that device and is removed when you sign out of Shop mode, once nothing is waiting to be sent. Keep your phones locked.

When you say a sale, the speech is turned into words on the phone itself. The recording never leaves the phone and is not kept. Only the sale you check and confirm is sent. The speech model is downloaded once from Bizora and kept on the phone until you remove it in Settings.
This page will be replaced after counsel reviews it. Until then, do not treat it as a finished privacy notice.

termsSections.title: 1. This agreement
paragraphs: These Terms of use are an agreement between you and Bizora ("Bizora", "we", "us"). They apply when you create a business on Bizora or use it in any way: the website, the app on a phone or computer, and shop phones.

You accept them by ticking "I agree to the Terms of use" when you sign up, or when the app asks you to. If you accept for a business, you confirm that you are allowed to agree for it. If you do not agree, do not use Bizora.
Our Privacy notice explains how we handle personal information. It forms part of these terms.

termsSections.title: 2. Your account
paragraphs: You must be an adult where you live and give true details when you sign up. Keep your password and your staff PINs to yourself.
You decide who works in your business on Bizora, and what each person may do. You are responsible for what you, your staff and the shop phones you add do in your business.
Tell us at once through Help in the app if you think someone else is using your account.

termsSections.title: 3. Using Bizora
paragraphs: Bizora helps you record sales, stock, customers and what they owe, suppliers, jobs, expenses and cash. It is a record-keeping tool. It is not accounting, tax, legal or financial advice.
Check the figures Bizora shows against your money and stock regularly. Keep your own copies of anything important, such as invoices you must keep by law.
Do not use Bizora to break the law, to cheat or harm anyone, to send messages people did not ask for, to get into other people's accounts, to copy or take apart the service, or to overload it.

termsSections.title: 4. Your business data
paragraphs: The records you enter belong to your business. You give us permission to store, copy, process and show them only so far as needed to run Bizora for you, keep it secure, and meet the law.

You must be allowed to keep the details of your customers, staff and suppliers that you enter, and tell them why you keep them. Data protection law where those people live applies to you, for example the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, the GDPR in the EU and UK, or the Data Protection Act in Ghana or Kenya.
For your customers' and staff's details, you decide why they are kept and we keep them on your behalf. We do not sell personal data and we do not use your records for advertising.

termsSections.title: 5. When Bizora staff can see your business
paragraphs: By accepting these terms you agree that authorised Bizora staff may see your business's account and records without asking you each time. This covers your sales, stock, customers and what they owe, suppliers, jobs, money, staff, shop phones and activity.

We look only when it is needed: to answer a request for help from you or your staff, to fix a fault or check that figures are right, to keep Bizora secure, to look into fraud, abuse or a dispute, or when the law requires it.

Only staff whose job needs it can look, and they are bound to keep what they see confidential. They see your records read-only, for at most one hour at a time, and must give a reason before they start. Customers' phone numbers and emails are partly hidden from them.
Every look and every action is recorded with the staff member's email, the time and the reason. As the owner you can see this list in the app under Settings, Bizora support.

Bizora staff never create, change or delete your sales, stock, payments or other records. They may do for you what you could do yourself and ask them to do, such as sending an invitation again or stopping a lost shop phone, and they may change your plan's limits. These actions are recorded in the same list.

termsSections.title: 6. Photo and voice reading
paragraphs: When you send a photo, scan or voice note to fill in a sale, stock or a job, it is read by an AI service run for us by Google Cloud. What comes back is a draft: check it before you save it.
Each shop can make a set number of reads a day. We may change that number, and we tell you in the app when a shop reaches it.

termsSections.title: 7. Plans and fees
paragraphs: Bizora is free to use for now. Before we charge for a plan, we will tell you the price and what it includes at least 30 days ahead, and you can choose whether to continue.
Prices will not include taxes unless we say so. Money you pay is not refundable unless the law or the plan says it is.

termsSections.title: 8. The service
paragraphs: We work to keep Bizora available and your records safe, with backups. Bizora is provided as it is: it may sometimes be unavailable, for example for maintenance or because of your network. Work saved on a phone with no network is sent when the network comes back.
We may change, add or remove features. If a change takes away something important you use, we will tell you ahead where we can.

termsSections.title: 9. Suspending or closing an account
paragraphs: You can stop using Bizora at any time and ask us to close your business's account. You can ask us for a copy of your records first.

We may limit or suspend an account that breaks these terms, puts other people or the service at risk, or that the law requires us to suspend. Where we can, we tell you first and give you a chance to fix the problem.
After an account is closed we delete its records within a reasonable time, except what the law requires us to keep.

termsSections.title: 10. Responsibility
paragraphs: As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for loss of profit, business or goodwill, or for losses caused by wrong figures you did not check, by your staff, or by events we cannot control.

As far as the law allows, our total responsibility to you is limited to what you paid us for Bizora in the 12 months before the problem, or 50,000 Nigerian naira (or the same value in your currency) if you paid nothing.
Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have by law that cannot be taken away, or limits responsibility for death, injury or fraud.

termsSections.title: 11. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms. When we do, we change the version above and the app asks you to accept the new version before you continue. If you do not accept, you can ask us to close your account.

termsSections.title: 12. Law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. If we disagree, we will first try to settle it by talking. If that fails, the courts of Nigeria decide, unless the law of your country lets you go to your own courts.
Contact us through Help in the app.

termsSections.title: 13. The pilot
paragraphs: Bizora is being tried with a small number of businesses before it is offered to everyone (the pilot). During the pilot, Bizora is a test version: it may have faults, change often, or be unavailable at times, and features may be added, changed or removed. It is not a finished product, and Bizora does not hold any security or data protection certification.

Bizora support may see your business's records, read-only, to help you, fix faults and keep the service safe, as section 5 explains. Every look is recorded and shown to you in Settings, Bizora support.

Your records are kept by Google Cloud for us. We keep backups of the service, but a backup is not a promise that nothing can ever be lost. Keep your own copy: the owner can download all of the business's records from Settings, as often as they like.

Some features are marked experimental, such as saying a sale. They may be wrong more often than other features. Check everything they fill in before you confirm it. We may switch a feature on or off for your business, for example to find a fault; you can see every change and its reason in Settings.

So that you can work with no network, Bizora keeps a copy of your products, prices, stock, the names of customers you may sell to, and the work you do offline, on the phone or computer you use, until that work is sent. Anyone who can open that phone may see it. Lock your phones, sign out of phones you no longer use, and do not clear the browser's data while work is waiting to be sent: work that was never sent cannot be recovered by us.

When you say a sale, the speech is turned into words on your phone. The recording is not sent to us and is not kept. Speech can be misheard, especially names, numbers and amounts, in noise, or with accents and languages it has not been tested on. It is tested in English only. Nothing said is saved until you check it and confirm it.

Bizora helps you keep your records. It is not accounting, tax or legal advice, and it does not replace an accountant or a tax adviser. Check the figures before you rely on them for tax returns, loans or other decisions.
The pilot may end. If it does, we will tell you at least 30 days ahead, and you can download your records before your account is closed.
